source: Read-only aggregates of rents.communities and rents.weekly_snapshots.
scope: Communities and observations in non-provisional markets (market NOT LIKE 'NEW-%').
historical_record_definition: One units-array floor-plan/bedroom-square-footage group with a numeric rent_min greater than zero in a snapshot whose status is live_data. Repeated observations over time count separately; these are not unique apartments or executed leases.
